items.snippet_en: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check Unit has debunked claims that Prime Minister Modi is offering free mobile recharge, stating no such scheme exists. Some claims are linked to digitally altered videos or AI-generated content featuring PM Modi. The government advises citizens to verify information about government schemes only through the official website myscheme.gov.in.

outputs.notes_en: The claim that Prime Minister Modi is offering all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge is false. The PIB Fact Check Unit has consistently debunked these claims, confirming that no such government scheme exists. These viral messages are often scams designed to trick users into clicking fraudulent links, potentially leading to data theft. Some claims use digitally altered videos or AI-generated content featuring PM Modi. Citizens are advised to verify government scheme information only through the official website myscheme.gov.in.
